chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 557: Li Huowang arrives too late—Princess Anping is dead and the Dice wins
chapter_meta_description: A shocking hospital confession leads to a storm-ridden chase. Li Huowang finds a skull-pyramid, a dead princess, and a patched-robed Daoist who has already won the game.
og_title: Li Huowang Arrives Too Late 🕰️💀 | Chapter 557
og_description: A desperate ride through the rain ends at a burning palace. Princess Anping is dead, and the Dice’s plan is complete.
twitter_title: The Dice wins. Ji Lin’s path is clear. Li Huowang arrives too late.
twitter_description: Sun Xiaoqin’s gentle care. Dr. Yi’s new plan. A beheaded princess. This chapter is a masterpiece of tragic timing.

lore_anchors.definition: A historical Chinese practice of stacking enemy severed heads into a monument to display military might and demoralize opponents. In the novel, it signifies a deliberate act of political terror.
A high-ranking member of the Zuowandao. He specializes in long-term political manipulation and has been engineering Great Qi’s succession crisis for hundreds of chapters.
The name the patched-robed Daoist uses for Li Huowang. It may be a mishearing or deliberate mockery, possibly related to Li Huowang’s alias or lack of a formal title in this context.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang refuse to eat the apple?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is simultaneously conscious in his hospital body and riding a horse in the Dao-Twisted World. Eating in one reality could disrupt his physical continuity in the other.

A powerful agent of the Zuowandao, likely a high-ranking member tasked with eliminating the last royal contender to secure Ji Lin’s ascension. His turtle-head dodge and calm mockery suggest he is a seasoned combatant.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does killing the Daoist matter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: If only the Daoist knows Princess Anping is dead, then by killing him, Li Huowang can prevent the news from spreading. This keeps the fiction that she is still alive—effectively blocking Ji Lin’s coronation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is Dr. Yi Donglai’s new treatment plan?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not yet revealed, but he claims to have found “patterns” and “weaknesses” in Li Huowang’s condition. It will likely involve some form of psychological or pharmaceutical intervention that directly targets his dual-reality cognition.
